body:
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
    msg db "Hello, world", 10
    len equ $ - msg
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, msg
    mov rdx, len
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

add_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    add rax, rsi
    ret

sub_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    sub rax, rsi
    ret

mul_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    imul rax, rsi
    ret

div_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cqo
    idiv rsi
    ret

mod_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cqo
    idiv rsi
    mov rax, rdx
    ret

max_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    ret

min_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmovg rax, rsi
    ret

abs_val:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    cmovs rax, rdi
    ret

negate:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    ret

swap:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov ecx, [rsi]
    mov [rdi], ecx
    mov [rsi], eax
    ret

strlen_custom:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    cmp byte [rdi + rax], 0
    je .done
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

my_memcpy:
    mov rcx, rdx
    rep movsb
    ret

my_memset:
    mov rcx, rdx
    mov al, sil
    rep stosb
    ret

strcmp_custom:
.loop:
    mov al, [rdi]
    mov cl, [rsi]
    cmp al, cl
    jne .different
    test al, al
    je .equal
    inc rdi
    inc rsi
    jmp .loop
.different:
    movzx rax, al
    movzx rcx, cl
    sub rax, rcx
    ret
.equal:
    xor rax, rax
    ret

reverse_string:
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov rdx, rdi
.len:
    cmp byte [rdx + rcx], 0
    je .start
    inc rcx
    jmp .len
.start:
    dec rcx
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    cmp rax, rcx
    jge .done
    mov sil, [rdi + rax]
    mov r8b, [rdi + rcx]
    mov [rdi + rax], r8b
    mov [rdi + rcx], sil
    inc rax
    dec rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

to_upper:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    mov cl, [rdi + rax]
    test cl, cl
    je .done
    cmp cl, 'a'
    jb .next
    cmp cl, 'z'
    ja .next
    sub cl, 32
    mov [rdi + rax], cl
.next:
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

to_lower:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    mov cl, [rdi + rax]
    test cl, cl
    je .done
    cmp cl, 'A'
    jb .next
    cmp cl, 'Z'
    ja .next
    add cl, 32
    mov [rdi + rax], cl
.next:
    inc rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

sum_array:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    add eax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

max_array:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    cmp edx, eax
    cmovg eax, edx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

min_array:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    cmp edx, eax
    cmovl eax, edx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

count_evens:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    test edx, 1
    jnz .next
    inc eax
.next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

count_positive:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    cmp dword [rdi + rcx * 4], 0
    jle .next
    inc eax
.next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

linear_search:
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .missing
    cmp [rdi + rcx * 4], edx
    je .found
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.found:
    mov rax, rcx
    ret
.missing:
    mov rax, -1
    ret

count_occurrences:
    xor eax, eax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    cmp [rdi + rcx * 4], edx
    jne .next
    inc eax
.next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

binary_search:
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov r8, rsi
    dec r8
.loop:
    cmp rcx, r8
    jg .missing
    mov r9, rcx
    add r9, r8
    shr r9, 1
    cmp [rdi + r9 * 4], edx
    je .found
    jl .right
    mov r8, r9
    dec r8
    jmp .loop
.right:
    mov rcx, r9
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.found:
    mov rax, r9
    ret
.missing:
    mov rax, -1
    ret

bubble_sort:
    xor rcx, rcx
.outer:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    xor rdx, rdx
.inner:
    mov r8, rsi
    sub r8, rcx
    dec r8
    cmp rdx, r8
    jge .next
    mov eax, [rdi + rdx * 4]
    mov r9d, [rdi + rdx * 4 + 4]
    cmp eax, r9d
    jle .skip
    mov [rdi + rdx * 4], r9d
    mov [rdi + rdx * 4 + 4], eax
.skip:
    inc rdx
    jmp .inner
.next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .outer
.done:
    ret

insertion_sort:
    mov rcx, 1
.outer:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov eax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    mov rdx, rcx
.inner:
    test rdx, rdx
    jz .place
    cmp [rdi + rdx * 4 - 4], eax
    jle .place
    mov r8d, [rdi + rdx * 4 - 4]
    mov [rdi + rdx * 4], r8d
    dec rdx
    jmp .inner
.place:
    mov [rdi + rdx * 4], eax
    inc rcx
    jmp .outer
.done:
    ret

factorial:
    mov rax, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    imul rax, rdi
    dec rdi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

fib:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rdx, rax
    add rdx, rcx
    mov rax, rcx
    mov rcx, rdx
    dec rdi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

climb_stairs:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    mov rdx, rax
    add rdx, rcx
    mov rax, rcx
    mov rcx, rdx
    dec rdi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    mov rax, rcx
    ret

gcd:
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rax, rdi
    div rsi
    mov rdi, rsi
    mov rsi, rdx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    mov rax, rdi
    ret

power:
    mov rax, 1
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    imul rax, rdi
    dec rsi
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

is_even:
    mov rax, rdi
    and rax, 1
    xor rax, 1
    ret

is_prime:
    cmp rdi, 2
    jl .no
    mov rcx, 2
.loop:
    mov rax, rcx
    imul rax, rcx
    cmp rax, rdi
    jg .yes
    mov rax, rdi
    xor rdx, rdx
    div rcx
    test rdx, rdx
    jz .no
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.yes:
    mov rax, 1
    ret
.no:
    xor rax, rax
    ret

count_set_bits:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rcx, rdi
    and rcx, 1
    add rax, rcx
    shr rdi, 1
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

is_power_of_two:
    test rdi, rdi
    jle .no
    mov rax, rdi
    dec rax
    and rax, rdi
    jz .yes
.no:
    xor rax, rax
    ret
.yes:
    mov rax, 1
    ret

sum_digits:
    xor r8, r8
    mov rcx, 10
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rax, rdi
    xor rdx, rdx
    div rcx
    add r8, rdx
    mov rdi, rax
    jmp .loop
.done:
    mov rax, r8
    ret

reverse_bits:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 32
.loop:
    shl rax, 1
    mov rdx, rdi
    and rdx, 1
    or rax, rdx
    shr rdi, 1
    dec rcx
    jnz .loop
    ret

is_palindrome:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rdx, rdi
.len:
    cmp byte [rdx + rax], 0
    je .start
    inc rax
    jmp .len
.start:
    dec rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rax
    jge .yes
    mov r8b, [rdi + rcx]
    mov r9b, [rdi + rax]
    cmp r8b, r9b
    jne .no
    inc rcx
    dec rax
    jmp .loop
.yes:
    mov rax, 1
    ret
.no:
    xor rax, rax
    ret

single_number:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    xor rax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

missing_number:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .finish
    xor rax, rcx
    xor rax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.finish:
    xor rax, rsi
    ret

atoi:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov r8, 1
    cmp byte [rdi], '-'
    jne .loop
    mov r8, -1
    inc rcx
.loop:
    movzx rdx, byte [rdi + rcx]
    test rdx, rdx
    jz .done
    sub rdx, '0'
    imul rax, rax, 10
    add rax, rdx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    imul rax, r8
    ret

clamp:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rax, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    cmp rax, rdx
    cmovg rax, rdx
    ret

sign:
    xor rax, rax
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rax, 1
    jg .done
    mov rax, -1
.done:
    ret

sum_squares:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov rdx, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    imul rdx, rdx
    add rax, rdx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

fill_array:
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov [rdi + rcx * 4], edx
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

count_vowels:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    mov dl, [rdi + rcx]
    test dl, dl
    jz .done
    or dl, 32
    cmp dl, 'a'
    je .hit
    cmp dl, 'e'
    je .hit
    cmp dl, 'i'
    je .hit
    cmp dl, 'o'
    je .hit
    cmp dl, 'u'
    jne .next
.hit:
    inc rax
.next:
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret

dot_product:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rdx
    jge .done
    mov r8d, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    imul r8d, [rsi + rcx * 4]
    add rax, r8
    inc rcx
    jmp .loop
.done:
    ret
